image_description: A close-up shot of a dessert featuring a scoop of white ice cream (likely vanilla or berry-swirl) sitting atop a golden-brown pastry base. The ice cream is garnished with fresh mint leaves, a slice of red strawberry, and what appears to be candied fruit or crystallized petals. There are visible signs of melting, with liquid pooling slightly on the pastry.
